meta.title: SkillRoster · inspect, prepare, execute, undo
meta.subtitle: Local CLI architecture · persisted handoffs, not an automatic pipeline · pinned at 21d14c7

components.label: Discover & inspect
components.explanation: Discover known Agent, shared, explicit and plugin roots; locate SKILL.md, inspect links, parse metadata and fingerprint packages. Include bounded session evidence and coverage. app.rs freezes durable source-read permissions and persists the Scan Snapshot transactionally; report builds deterministic Findings. No Skill package mutation is performed here. This is not globally read-only: local control state is written.

components.label: Validate & prepare
components.explanation: The caller chooses intent and supplies a structured decision. Require the latest Snapshot and governance Evidence; normalize one request family per Plan. Trusted workflows derive filesystem operations from Roster, Library or source-update requests; raw Agent operations are refused. change::prepare validates roots, operation policy, current fingerprints and projected state, then hashes the prepared operations. Save immutable Plan content in SQLite; do not execute it. The outgoing handoff is a stored Plan and ID, not a call that automatically applies it.

components.label: Apply / Undo controller
components.explanation: Separate explicit CLI invocations, not automatic Plan execution. Human mode previews and confirms; --json skips that prompt. Apply requires a Ready Plan, clear recovery journals, the current Snapshot and matching governance/evidence/placement state. Undo loads an Applied Receipt and refuses repeat reversal. Under the state lock, delegate actual filesystem operations to change.rs. After verification, update or restore Roster/Library metadata and save Receipt/status in SQLite. Metadata failure after Apply triggers filesystem rollback; incomplete reconciliation becomes RecoveryRequired.

components.label: Local Skill filesystem
components.explanation: The same local filesystem is inspected first and changed only later. Read scope and mutation scope differ: discovered plugin packages are explicitly non-governable, while confirmed source roots grant read access, not blanket mutation permission. The mutation engine acts on normalized, approved targets. Supported execution primitives include symlink creation/removal, copy, recoverable move, directory creation and controlled file write/replace. This node is a logical collection of local paths, not a remote service.

components.label: Receipt & recovery files
components.explanation: change.rs publishes private JSON journals atomically through AnchoredFs before and during mutation, recording operation outcomes and compensations. Recovery material may be in state recovery directories or alongside moved/removed paths; it is not all in SQLite. Undo consumes the original Receipt's compensations in reverse and creates a new reverse Receipt. Journal and SQLite commits are separate durability domains: a durable filesystem journal can survive failed database finalization.

components.label: Reversible change engine
components.explanation: apply_locked obtains an anchored filesystem from the state lock and approved roots. Revalidate the Plan digest, current operation sequence and before-state projections; require atomic no-replace rename support. Journal compensation before execution, recheck at execution, verify after-state projections, and compensate on failure. Undo rejects unresolved recovery and repeat reversal, journals a new reverse Receipt and runs fingerprint-guarded compensations in reverse. Drift or incomplete compensation is not permission to overwrite unrelated files; it can require recovery.

boundaries.label: INSPECT / PREPARE · no Skill writes; SQLite state may change

cards.title: Control state is not Skill content
items: StateStore persists Snapshots, Evidence, Findings, immutable Plans and Receipts in skillroster.db.
Inspection/preparation may write that database and secure local state; they do not apply package operations.

cards.title: Who decides, and who writes?
items: The caller chooses intent; trusted normalization derives operations. Raw Agent filesystem operations are refused.
Human Apply/Undo prompts are skipped in --json mode; there is no universal interactive approval gate.

cards.title: Undo is guarded compensation
items: Applied Receipt → fingerprint-checked reverse compensations → new reverse Receipt → metadata restoration.
Failed rollback/finalization can require lifecycle recovery; this is not one atomic SQLite + filesystem transaction.
Implementation overview only; actual installed roots and platform durability were not exercised.
